title: 第23章 行了治好了第24章 得拜师
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
女明星脚步一顿，身体愣了一下，缓缓转过身，透过墨镜警惕地看向陈阳，声音带着刚哭过的沙哑：“你是谁？
找我有什么事？”
陈阳缓步走上前，语气平静却带着十足的底气：“你的病，我有办法治好，不用开刀，也不用切除。”
女明星闻言，浑身一震。
猛地摘下墨镜，露出一双红肿的眼睛，眼神里满是怀疑，却又夹杂着一丝不易察觉的期待：“你说什么？
你真的能治好我的病？
不用开刀？”
陈阳点了点头，随即转身推开钟知夏办公室的门走了进去。
此时，钟知夏正靠在椅子上伸着懒腰，忙碌了一天的她满脸疲惫，正准备收拾东西下班。
看到突然走进来的陈阳，她愣了一下，随即认出了他，疑惑问：“是你？难道是刘小姐有什么东西落在我这儿了？”
“不是。”陈阳摇了摇头，直截了当说：“我来找你谈合作。”
就在这时，钟知夏余光瞥见刚才那位女明星也跟着走了进来，脸上还带着未干的泪痕。
女明星快步走到钟知夏面前，激动地抓住她的胳膊，声音都在发抖：“钟医生！您是不是有其他不用开刀的办法？您快告诉我！”
她说着，猛地指向陈阳，“刚才这个人说，他可以治好我的病，不用开刀！”
钟知夏瞳孔一缩，猛地转头看向陈阳，眼神里满是探究和急切。
陈阳迎着她的目光，平静地点了点头，确认了女明星的话。
钟知夏的心脏“砰砰”狂跳起来，她强压下心中的激动，对着女明星说：“陈小姐，麻烦你先出去一下，我先跟他谈一谈。”
女明星虽然心急如焚，但也只好依依不舍地看了陈阳一眼，转身退出了办公室，顺手关上了门。
办公室门一关上，钟知夏就迫不及待问：“陈先生，你刚才说能治好她的病，难道你有什么专治乳腺疾病的秘方？”
她的眼神里满是期待，却又带着几分怀疑。

毕竟乳腺重病不用开刀就能治好，这实在太匪夷所思了。
“不是药方。”陈阳摇了摇头，说：“是我家祖传的推拿手法。”
“推拿手法？”钟知夏脸上的期待瞬间褪去，取而代之的是满满的失望，“光靠推拿，不可能治好这种程度的乳腺疾病吧？这不符合医学常识。”
她从医多年，从未听说过推拿能根治严重的乳腺病灶。
“如果再加上真气呢？”陈阳语气平淡说。
话音未落，他快步上前，伸手抓住了钟知夏放在桌上的手臂，一丝温和的真气顺势渡了过去。
钟知夏只觉得一股温暖的气流突然从手臂涌入，顺着经脉缓缓流淌，原本因久坐而有些酸胀的身体瞬间变得轻松起来。
她猛地睁大了眼睛，震惊地看着陈阳，声音都变了调：“你……你刚才做了什么？”
“没什么，只是给你传了一丝真气。”陈阳松开手，语气依旧平静。
钟知夏愣在原地，震惊、疑惑、难以置信等多种情绪在她眼中交织。
她活了这么大，还是第一次遇到这种匪夷所思的事情，一时之间竟不知道该如何反应。
“我现在就证明给你看。”陈阳说完，转身打开门，让刚才那位女明星进来。
女明星立刻快步走了进来，再次抓住钟知夏的手，急切地哀求道：“钟医生，求求您，一定要救救我！
content_en:
The female star paused in her steps, froze for a moment, turned around slowly, looked at Chen Yang warily through her sunglasses, her voice was hoarse as if she had just cried: "Who are you?
What do you want from me? "
Chen Yang walked forward slowly, his tone calm but full of confidence: "I have a way to cure your disease without surgery or removal."
The female star was shocked when she heard this.
He suddenly took off his sunglasses, revealing a pair of red and swollen eyes, full of suspicion, but mixed with a hint of unnoticeable expectation: "What did you say?
Can you really cure my disease?
No need for surgery? "
Chen Yang nodded, then turned around and pushed open the door of Zhong Zhixia's office and walked in.
At this time, Zhong Zhixia was leaning on a chair and stretching. She looked exhausted after a busy day and was about to pack her things and get off work.
Seeing Chen Yang suddenly walking in, she was stunned for a moment, then recognized him and asked doubtfully: "Is it you? Did Miss Liu leave something with me?"
"No." Chen Yang shook his head and said bluntly: "I came to you to discuss cooperation."
At this moment, Zhong Zhixia caught a glimpse of the female star walking in from the corner of her eye, with wet tears still on her face.
The female star walked quickly to Zhong Zhixia and grabbed her arm excitedly, her voice trembling: "Doctor Zhong! Do you have any other methods that don't require surgery? Tell me quickly!"
As she spoke, she pointed at Chen Yang, "This man just said that he can cure my disease without surgery!"
Zhong Zhixia's pupils shrank and she suddenly turned her head to look at Chen Yang, her eyes full of inquiry and eagerness.
Chen Yang met her gaze and nodded calmly, confirming what the female star said.
Zhong Zhixia's heart was beating wildly. She suppressed the excitement in her heart and said to the female star: "Miss Chen, please go out first, and I will talk to him first."
Although the female star was anxious, she could only look at Chen Yang reluctantly, turned around and exited the office, closing the door.
As soon as the office door closed, Zhong Zhixia couldn't wait to ask: "Mr. Chen, you just said you could cure her disease. Do you have any secret recipe for treating breast disease?"
Her eyes were full of expectation, but also a bit suspicious.
After all, it’s incredible that serious breast disease can be cured without surgery.
"It's not a prescription." Chen Yang shook his head and said, "It's a massage technique passed down by my family."
"Massage technique?" The expectation on Zhong Zhixia's face faded instantly, replaced by full of disappointment, "It's impossible to cure this level of breast disease just by massage, right? This is not in line with medical common sense."
She has been practicing medicine for many years and has never heard that massage can cure serious breast lesions.
"What if we add true energy?" Chen Yang said calmly.
Before he finished speaking, he stepped forward quickly, reached out and grabbed Zhong Zhixia's arm on the table, and a gentle breath of energy flowed through it.
Zhong Zhixia only felt a warm air flow suddenly pouring in from her arms and flowing slowly along her meridians. Her body, which was originally a little sore from sitting for a long time, instantly became relaxed.
She opened her eyes suddenly and looked at Chen Yang in shock, her voice changing tone: "You...what did you just do?"
"It's nothing, I just passed on a little bit of vitality to you." Chen Yang let go of his hand, his tone still calm.
Zhong Zhixia froze on the spot, shock, confusion, disbelief and other emotions intertwined in her eyes.
This was the first time in her life that she encountered such an incredible thing, and she didn't know how to react for a moment.
"I'll prove it to you now." After Chen Yang finished speaking, he turned around and opened the door, letting in the female star just now.
The female star immediately walked in quickly, grabbed Zhong Zhixia's hand again, and begged urgently: "Doctor Zhong, please, please save me!
